content: {"episode_id":"ep-05006","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity review is requested for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), denied under CO-197 with prior authorization missing.
